acceptanceCriteria: affected models rule (d) or states which readers keep scope UNKNOWN and why.
The CEM sidecar narrowing is mirrored, or the extra selections are listed with a reason, with a test.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. Residual from V1-0126 (merged). After AFP-V0-021, `corvint affected` selects the packages that read a changed doc, but the scope stays UNKNOWN because the gate's rule (d) for unbounded readers is not modelled, and the CEM sidecar narrowing is not mirrored, which adds noise to the selection. Related: V1-0081 (rule (d) floor in gate-affected).
title: affected: gate rule (d) for unbounded readers and the CEM sidecar narrowing are not modelled
